cleanupFailure.fault: Retirement plan digest deliberately changed after target installation, before helper validation

assertionBasis: The curator independently compares recorded source and held data, complete before/after old-ledger rows, approvals, due times, archive hashes and outcomes. Postflight reads stopped volumes to validate live pins, persisted acknowledgments, retired audits and unchanged scoped credentials, then compares source volume bytes and complete names. Replica process readiness, actual container node/bucket environment, API/CLI refusals and initial fresh seed-row comparisons are assertions in the fingerprinted driver. Terminal exit0 observations are operator facts. Manifest identifiers refer to full private manifests; row and namespace fingerprints are computed over retained private evidence.

sourceChangesSinceEarlierProfiles.reason: The helper now removes a stopped target if post-install plan validation fails; its failure path was exercised separately. Earlier receipts retain their recorded source versions.

limits: Private qualification controller supplies CronRuntime; ordinary scoped cron upload remains rejected
